verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration-services provider with case dashboards and People Ops integration, so a programmatic integration surface such as SDKs is a plausible question for it. However, no evidence shows any official SDK. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404, and the 'plug into your People Ops' claim describes a service process, not a developer SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
